liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half Step Uptown Toodle-Loo** (2 reviews): Listener identifies this as the best version heard, featuring some of Jerry's best soloing; Reviewer believes the band played the best Mississippi Half Step of their careers on this date [14][20]
- **Big River** (1 review): The transition from Mississippi Half-Step into Big River sounds like it is about to be disco [12]

## The recordings

- **gd77-05-07.sbd.bertha-ashley.26361.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 4.97/5 by 30 [1]
- **gd77-05-07.rolfe.weiner.6021.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 193 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: Listener notes the soundboard has great versions of Friend of the Devil, Terrapin, and Wheel [16]
- **gd1977-05-07.sbd.miller.88525.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 189 min; rated 4.72/5 by 40 [4]
- **gd77-05-07.sbd.unknown.262.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 164 min; rated 4.72/5 by 53 [9]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the audio as perfect, with music bubbling and the song feeling good; Garcia's solo in Big River is so revved up he nearly leaves the drummers behind; Listener praises the sound quality on expensive stereo systems, highlighting the Wheel to Wharf Rat sequence [10][15][19][21]

## Around the show

- Billy's birthday was celebrated during the show, though the band's equipment malfunctioned at showtime [6]
- Kathy Sublette recorded the show, noting the crowd was rowdy but good natured despite equipment issues [8]
- Reviewer rates this performance above the next night, citing inspired song choice and best version [11]
- Reviewer claims this show tops the Cornell performance, citing song selection and a near-reggae Friend of the Devil [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-05-07.sbd.bertha-ashley.26361.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Jay Ashley remastered the Rob Eaton soundboard source through DAT, editing, and DAW stages [1]
- **gd77-05-07.rolfe.weiner.6021.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM 33P mic > TC-152 deck [3]
- **gd1977-05-07.sbd.miller.88525.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) D [4]. Also: Miller transfer uses a Sony ECM 33P cassette master, with pitch adjusted to match the reel [4]
- **gd77-05-07.sbd.unknown.262.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Paper Moon, il negozio on-line della tua musica: [GRATEFUL DEAD - Boston Garden, MA 5.7.1977 - Limited Edition Rsd 2023 Exclusive | 0603497838356](https://www.papmoon.com/grateful-dead-boston-garden-ma-5-7-1977-limited-edition-rsd-2023-exclusive_44795.html) [23]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [current-page:url:arg:3 | Grateful Dead](https://www.dead.net/tags/boston-garden) [24]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - May 7 1977 Boston | Caine Schneider | …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/34357371292/) [25]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/34357371292/) [26]
